title: Ordering Channels and Service Equipment Charges under the Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
## Ordering channel

Two figures are printed against each service level of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement for the channel by which orders are placed: whether orders may be placed through the client ordering portal, and the surcharge for an order taken by telephone rather than through that portal.

## Service equipment

Two further figures cover chafing, urn and display equipment: the refundable deposit held for rented service equipment, and the charge for each day rented equipment is returned late.

| Service level | Client ordering portal | Telephone surcharge | Equipment deposit | Late return charge per day |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | yes | 5.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Delivered Buffet Account | yes | 5.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 25.00 USD |
| Attended Buffet Account | yes | 0.00 USD | 450.00 USD | 60.00 USD |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | yes | 0.00 USD | 1200.00 USD | 120.00 USD |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | no | 0.00 USD | 1800.00 USD | 175.00 USD |
| Campus Catering Master Account | yes | 0.00 USD | 2500.00 USD | 200.00 USD |

The telephone surcharge of 5.00 USD is printed against the two lowest service levels only. The Executive Hospitality Catering Account is the one level in the schedule whose client ordering portal is not enabled, and the surcharge printed against it is 0.00 USD.
